```plato

// Renders triangle edges as lines of WireThickness pixels in WireColor, over
// faces filled with FaceColor; use a fully transparent FaceColor for edges
// only. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wire-frame_model)
type WireframeMaterial
    implements IValue
{
    WireColor: Color;
    FaceColor: Color;
    WireThickness: Number;
}
```
